about_the_game:
All kinds of shelves, colorful books, and a warm little shop!

Shelf by Shelf is a cozy simulation game that blends the love of books with a relaxing organizing experience. Arrange books on shelves, sort them by genre, and decorate your store. Spending time in a tidy and warm bookshop will make you feel great!

What Awaits You in Shelf by Shelf?

🦆 A Place for Everything
Whether it’s colorful books with vibrant covers or your personal items, organize your shelves just the way you like. Fill them up, enrich your collection, and create libraries that appeal to every reader!

📚 From Dusty Shelves to Grand Libraries
Start with a cozy reading corner and grow into a bustling bookstore filled to the brim. Expand your space with new furniture, decorations, and collections.

💭 Requests Come In, You Deliver
From local residents to book clubs, fulfill orders for different customers, prepare special collections, and invest your earnings back into your shop.

🏢 Your Shop, Your Style
Colorful covers, elegant furniture, and character-filled decorations… All the details to make your bookstore unique are in your hands!

Key Features

✔ Soft-toned, warm, and comforting visuals
✔ Relaxing and smooth organizing mechanics
✔ Carefully selected literary works to expand your general knowledge
✔ A gameplay pace that soothes rather than stresses
✔ Hidden little surprises waiting to be discovered

Add Shelf by Shelf to your wishlist so you can be the first to fill those shelves!

name: Shelf by Shelf: Bookstore Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 4.Gen / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / NVIDIA GT 710 / Radeon R5 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Work in a warm, cozy bookstore, sort books by genre, and brighten your shelves! Shelf by Shelf invites you into a peaceful world with satisfying organizing mechanics. Help local readers find the perfect books, make them happy, grow your earnings, and expand your shop!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Simplified Chinese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Japanese*, Korean*, Spanish - Latin America*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support
